emma (marketing): Launch coordination thread \u2014 aiming to announce Wed 08:00 PT. Need: final changelog PR, public docs link, benchmark visuals, webinar CTA, and lead-routing setup. Who can confirm deliverables and timings?
chen (eng): Changelog PR ready for review (PR #501). Includes migration steps for header validation and key rotation. Can merge today if no blockers.
rosa (product): Once merged I'll kick the docs build and post the staging URL here. Expect staging -> prod swap after deploy.
kai (eng): Bench assets: I'll export p50/p95, tokens/sec, and cost-per-1k for three variants (prod-opt, quantized, tiny). Will add SVGs + CSV by EOD today.
emma (marketing): Webinar planned Thu 10:00 PT (30 min). Need a short blurb for each benchmark slide and one sentence CTA for signup. Also need canonical iframe snippet for embedding sign-up.
chen (eng): For onboarding copy: recommend we phrase the breaking change as "update headers to new validation rules" with link to migration guide. We'll provide a one-line curl snippet for rotation.
rosa (product): Landing path will be /docs/launch/1978-perf-compare. Use utm_campaign=redwood_launch_spring1978 and utm_medium=product_email. Emma, confirm UTM values?
emma (marketing): Confirmed. Sam, can you set lead tag "launch_warm" and route to inbound-sdr for 48h, escalate enterprise-size leads to AE queue?
sam (sales ops): Will do. Need final prod URL to validate routing. I can also send a test lead after links are live.
docs-bot: Docs build queued: staging -> prod in ~2h. CI green.
chen (eng): Canary plan: 10% first 30m, 40% next 2h, full traffic over 8h. Auto rollback on error rate >1% or latency +60% over baseline. We'll post a perf smoke 20m before publish.
emma (marketing): We'll post announcement in #marketing and email at 08:00 PT. Please post a go/no-go green 10m prior here. I'll assemble final copy (summary changelog, links, bench slides, webinar CTA, migration snippet, FAQ) and share 1 hour before send.
kai (eng): Bench assets uploaded internally: https://internal.redwood/launch1978/bench_assets.zip \u2014 will move public images to marketing drive when sanitized.
emma (marketing): Thanks everyone. If anything slips, call it out here. I'll schedule the webinar invite after slides are finalized. :rocket:
